purpose: Formalize and verify the stochastic layer that operates around the promoted deterministic stock-flow laws SL1-SL4.

laws.name: finite-subcohort recruitment sampling
laws.statement: For a frozen representative cohort with eligible fraction e, combined recruitment intensity I, recruitment rate r, elapsed interval dt, and n recruitment subcohorts: p = 1-exp(-r*I*dt), a=min(ceil(e*n),n), K~Binomial(a,p), and realized recruited fraction is min(K/n,e).
laws.implication: Conditional recruitment variance is intrinsic even when the hazard state is identical; the cap makes the exact expectation a finite binomial sum rather than simply e*p whenever e*n is non-integer.
verification: factor the exact probability and cap into a pure helper used by the production recruitment path without changing semantics
enumerate the exact finite distribution and moments
for selected cases, compare empirical draws from PyRandomCompat against the exact mean/variance with a preregistered Monte Carlo tolerance

laws.name: conditional organization-collapse hazard
laws.statement: When deterministic collapse gates are false and observed-active conditioning is absent, one organization-ecology interval collapses iff U<q for U~Uniform(0,1), where q=1-exp(-lambda*dt/7) and lambda=collapse_base_hazard*exp(2*(1-cohesion)+2*losses-3*social_base-1.5*external_sanctuary).
laws.implication: At frozen state, stochastic-collapse survival composes multiplicatively across intervals: 1-q(dt1+dt2)=(1-q(dt1))*(1-q(dt2)). Collapse risk rises monotonically with losses and falls monotonically with cohesion, social base, and sanctuary.
verification: factor the production collapse probability into a pure helper without changing semantics
test the semigroup identity across the full grid
test monotonic direction in each state variable
compare selected empirical Uniform draws to q with a preregistered binomial tolerance
verify deterministic capital/cohesion/rootedness gates still override the stochastic draw

promotion_rule: Promote SL5/SL6 only after the production code calls the verified pure helpers and all exact, monotonicity, semigroup, and Monte Carlo checks pass. A failed direction or distribution check blocks promotion.
claim_boundary: These are stochastic laws of the implemented Pineland process, not empirical distributions for real organizations.
guard: Do not modify production semantics while the preregistered mobilization-risk-frontier run is in progress.
